title: Credit Ruling: Returned-Payment Surcharge on the Security Deposits Reconnection Multiple
content:
**Applies to:** the reconnection multiple of the Residential Credit Reestablishment Deposit assessed under Security Deposits at the reconnection of a Schedule R or Schedule FH account whose waived deposit was reinstated.

## Ruling

The returned-payment surcharge is the repeat surcharge of **0.5** for two or more returned payments on the account being reconnected in the last twelve months, the single surcharge of **0.25** for exactly one, and nothing for none. The surcharge is added to the reconnection multiple. The returned payments counted are those recorded on the account's Electric Service by Rate Schedule payment history.

## Ladder

| Returned payments on the account, last twelve months | Surcharge |
|---|---|
| two or more | 0.5 |
| exactly one | 0.25 |
| none | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration

An account with a returned check in February and a returned bank draft in July of the past twelve months carries the 0.5 repeat surcharge; had only the July draft been returned, the surcharge would be 0.25.
